parameters.name: Grpc
parameters.description:
Whether to enable GRPC, default is disabled. Possible values:
- on: Enable
- off: Disable

parameters.name: Http2Origin
parameters.description:
Whether to enable HTTP2 origin, default is disabled. Possible values:
- on: Enable
- off: Disable

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description:
Rule content, using conditional expressions to match user requests. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration. There are two usage scenarios:
- Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true
- Match specific requests: Set the value to a custom expression, for example: (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

parameters.name: RuleEnable
parameters.description:
Rule switch. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration. Possible values:
- on: Enable.
- off: Disable.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: Rule name. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration.

parameters.name: Sequence
parameters.description: The rule execution order. A smaller numeric value indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: Site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) API.

parameters.name: SmartRouting
parameters.description:
Whether to enable the smart routing service, default is disabled. Possible values:
- on: Enable
- off: Disable

parameters.name: UploadMaxFilesize
parameters.description: Maximum upload file size, in MB, with a range of 100 to 500.

parameters.name: Websocket
parameters.description:
Whether to enable Websocket, default is enabled. Possible values:
- on: Enable
- off: Disable

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa update-network-optimization --site-id 1234560000 --config-id 352816096987136 --rule-name rule_example --rule-enable on --rule http.host_eq_video.example.com --smart-routing on --http2-origin on --websocket on --grpc on --upload-max-filesize 100 --sequence 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa UpdateNetworkOptimization --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234560000 --SmartRouting on --RuleEnable on --Websocket on --ConfigId 352816096987136 --Rule 'http.host_eq_video.example.com' --Sequence 1 --Grpc on --Http2Origin on --RuleName rule_example --UploadMaxFilesize 100
